rationale: The left node 'Điều kiện đường thẳng song song với mặt phẳng' is a theorem giving a condition for a line to be parallel to a plane. The right node 'Tính chất hai mặt phẳng song song' is a theorem about a property of two parallel planes. They are distinct theorems about parallelism in different geometric configurations (line-plane vs. plane-plane).
